title: Count Passing Scores
statement: A class's quiz scores are stored in an array, and a pass mark is given. Return how many scores are greater than or equal to the pass mark.

answerKey.pattern: Single linear scan with a counter
keyPoints: Visit each score once and add 1 when score >= mark
edgeCases: A score equal to the mark counts as passing
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sort and binary search for the mark: O(n log n)

hints: How many times do you need to look at each score?
A single counter is enough; no extra array is needed.
Use >= so that a score equal to the mark is counted.
